test: live Gazebo dynamic entity blocks a navigation goal on a flat segment
terrain_zone_intersection: none; route kept clear of the configured tunnel, slope and step zones
limitations: The box was manually repositioned after the active-goal snapshot; its exact removal timestamp was not recorded, so release latency is not claimed.
The dynamic model drifted about 0.25 m while it was left free. This confirms active/pending/resume behavior but does not certify a repeatable static-goal clearance distance.

The robot was still about 1.2 m from the goal at the 10-second status snapshot and took a broad detour. Approach efficiency and steady waiting distance need a more tightly controlled anchored-target run.
